//: Who may call what. src/main/roles.js is the only reader of the policy; the renderer gets viewer.allowed, nav, modes and hiddenPages in state and may import this file for labels and copy only. Every method in studio-api-channels.json sits in exactly one methodRoles group (test/roles.test.js); a method missing here is admin-only. A composite method is classified at least as high as anything it can run.

roles.label: Admin
roles.description: Everything, including settings, people and analytics.

roles.label: Editor
roles.description: Finds trends, writes and edits reports, makes assets for any channel.

roles.label: Channel owner
roles.description: Sees new trends and their channel’s assets, and says which trends they used.

copy.forbidden: Only editors and admins can do that. Ask an admin if you need it.
copy.adminOnly: Only an admin can do that.
copy.sharedSet: This set was made with other channels. Ask an editor.
copy.preview: You’re previewing as {who}. Switch back to Admin to make changes.
copy.alreadyMaking: Your {channel} assets for this trend are already being made.
copy.linkInvalid: This sign-in link doesn’t work anymore. Ask your studio admin for a new one.
copy.editConflict: {name} saved this report at {time}, after you opened it. Copy your text, reopen the report and try again.
copy.researchRunning: {name} started a search with this program at {time}. It’s still running.
copy.selfChange: You can’t change your own access. Ask another admin.
copy.lastAdmin: The studio needs at least one admin.
copy.serverAdmin: This person is an admin in the server settings.
copy.paused: Your access to this studio is paused.
copy.linksWebOnly: Sign-in links are for the web version.
copy.badLink: That doesn’t look like a web link.
copy.askPictures: Pictures aren’t set up for your team. Ask {admin} to turn them on.
copy.askDrive: Google Drive isn’t connected. Ask {admin} to connect it.
